1.consolidated_definition: Pluma prominente de la cola de un gallo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Prominent tail feather of a rooster.

reference_definitions: Pluma prominente de la cola de un gallo.

2.consolidated_definition: Laurel espada. Árbol no muy alto, de corteza color castaño claro y lisa. De ramas largas. Sus hojas y corteza tienen sabor a especias. Produce una baya parecida a una castaña. Su madera, color blanco rosado, es liviana; se usa como combustible.
2.en_consolidated_definition: Laurel sword tree. A relatively low-growing tree with a light brown and smooth bark. It has long branches. Its leaves and bark have a flavor reminiscent of spices. It produces a berry similar to a chestnut. Its wood, a pale pinkish white color, is lightweight; it is used as fuel.
